problem_type: Generation waiting visual diverges by admission path
symptom: Generating cards display a middle blue band instead of the chosen pixel animation.
direct_cause: A four-owner quota and motion/zoom/viewport gating select a CSS blue sweeping band.
class_root: Shared waiting presentation permits an unrelated fallback visual and an unmeasured instance-count threshold.
affected_population: Image/video generation, imports, reduced-motion and non-WebGL renderers
internal_only_reason: Application-owned admission and placeholder policy; installed img-fx source/API examined without changing its runtime.
invariants: All eligible visible image/video waiting surfaces use the existing img-fx animation without a four-owner quota.
Ineligible surfaces never show the removed blue band or run a fallback animation.
Existing viewport/zoom/motion constraints, honest progress and final cleanup stay enforced.

door_reduction.why_not: Generation and import need separate state producers (indeterminate wait versus byte progress), both already converge on one visual boundary. The shared boundary also retains the sole byte-progress reveal consumer.

generality_proof: Every generation kind and import feeds the same waiting component; deleting quota and band there removes both mechanisms across callers.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Own animation eligibility and static presentation for all consumers.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Direct consumer found by node scripts/door-map.mjs GenerationWaitingSurface; both pass real viewport and zoom to the boundary.
Direct consumer found by node scripts/door-map.mjs GenerationWaitingSurface; both pass real viewport and zoom to the boundary.

recurrence.reason: Any fifth node, reduced-motion renderer, zoomed-out or offscreen node reaches the blue band.
same_class_scan: rg static-band|waiting-band src tests: shared CSS plus performance/visual/import consumers
Read NodeGeneratingOverlay and NodeImportingOverlay wrappers; image/video/audio and byte-progress populations checked.

prevention.invariant: Eligible nodes reuse the grid effect; ineligible nodes have no blue band or independent sweeping animation.
prevention.failure_mode: Unavailable GPU/reduced motion/low zoom/offscreen uses a motionless grid; audio uses its existing bars.
prevention.strategy: Delete slot ownership and sweeping-band path at their sole owner; retain capability and lifecycle guards.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove four-slot registry and middle-band DOM/CSS; no duplicate animation implementation retained.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: img-fx runtime is unchanged; defect lies in the application quota/placeholder policy, not library behavior. Existing upstream renderer/pause/reveal APIs are reused.

migration: No persisted data changes; selectors in active tests and diagnostics follow the renamed static shell.
residual_risks: Performance beyond measured visible-node counts and on other physical devices is not inferred from this machine.

invariant_owner_layer.why: The single visual owner enforces eligibility and static presentation for both producers.
